capture.caveat: Actual ten-slot native gameplay capture after warmup, not fabricated full-rate rows. Counts include only due living teachers; deaths and cadence can reduce sustained throughput. Native encoding/queue publication are inside step cost; hashing, drain/decoding and reporting are outside it. No Node spool, HTTP, trainer, shadows, disk rotation or wall-debt scheduling is qualified. Queue drops remove complete chunks; exact-sample equality has no pass when any data was dropped. This does not select production resource defaults or prove a six-hour soak.

sensorContract.scalarEncoding: bipolar(x)=2*clamp(x,0,1)-1; arithmetic in f64, final finite Float32; signed zero preserved in numeric samples
sensorContract.angularGeometry: channel-major; centers=-pi+2*pi*i/B relative to heading; centered half-open sectors; +pi wraps to -pi
sensorContract.validityEncoding: all finite Float32; booleans/presence -1/+1; incomplete body/ray clearance -1 with scalar saturation +1; nearest motion fields zero when presence -1; urgency/density absent zero

scalarSemantics.label: tactical_size
scalarSemantics.meaning: bipolar(d/(d+40)); d=max(bodyLength-configuredStartLength,0); fraction also scales sensor ranges

scalarSemantics.label: boost_eligible
scalarSemantics.meaning: actual movement eligibility; zero positive spend impossible => -1; false=-1 true=+1

scalarSemantics.label: delivered_wallet_delta_norm
scalarSemantics.meaning: delta/(abs(delta)+10); delta=wallet minus previous delivered wallet; probes do not consume

scalarSemantics.label: current_life_points_norm
scalarSemantics.meaning: bipolar(lifePoints/(lifePoints+200)); evolved ledger or ordinary physical points

scalarSemantics.label: life_budget_used_norm
scalarSemantics.meaning: evolved off=-1; finite M=Float32(-livesStarted/M); unlimited=+1; baseline/external/retained=0

scalarSemantics.label: first_sample_of_life
scalarSemantics.meaning: +1 until accepted external or consumed internal observation in this physical life, then -1; takeover preserves flag

scalarSemantics.label: body_or_ray_query_saturated
scalarSemantics.meaning: body or capsule-ray query incomplete false=-1 true=+1

channels.label: far_food
channels.meaning: ring(near,far]; same bounded distance/value weight and saturation as near ring

channels.label: body_sector
channels.meaning: bipolar(min other-body segment clearance/near); collision radii scaled by configured hitScale; capped/incomplete raw clearance zero

channels.label: body_ray
channels.meaning: bipolar(first capsule intersection distance/near); ray through sector center; sum of collision radii with hitScale; tangency closed; incomplete=-1

channels.label: wall_ray
channels.meaning: bipolar(circular boundary ray clearance/near); arena radius minus observer collision radius

channels.label: head_clearance
channels.meaning: bipolar(min other-head disc clearance/near) in current relative bearing sector

channels.label: head_presence
channels.meaning: nearest head selected by minimum clearance then full internal ID; false=-1 true=+1

channels.label: head_bearing_residual
channels.meaning: clamp(wrapped nearest relative bearing minus sector center divided by pi/B,-1,+1)

channels.label: head_collision_urgency
channels.meaning: max(1-TTC/2) over all relevant held-motion disc intersections within 2s; sector is relative contact bearing; no collision=0

channels.label: head_density
channels.meaning: count/(count+4) for relevant heads in current bearing sector

caveat: Actual seeded native random-population gameplay with ten explicitly recorded v1/v2 baselines, duration-only completion, optional unlimited evolved respawn, and discard-new overflow. Includes authoritative complete steps and frame packing; excludes startup/checkpoint publication, Node/browser/network and observer analysis. Run-start uses a real immutable checkpoint plus matching benchmark acknowledgement, without SQLite. Simulated wall times are controlled; this does not measure wall-debt scheduling under load. This is not a trained-policy distribution, external-controller workload qualification, tactical agreement, ablation or final production-default selection. Clearance metres invert encoded Float32 channel minima and are censored at the sensing radius; incomplete body values are conservative, not ground truth. Pellet values use a systematic maximum-64 subset per committed boundary. Decaying due counts remain explicit; no zero-sample quality pass.
